_note: The 'what's new since you left' bullets in the ~1-month win-back email (scripts/send-winback.mts reads this; core/mailer.ts renders it). Edit freely to keep the email evergreen — no code change or redeploy of the app is needed, the next send picks it up. Keep it to 2-4 punchy items; 'title' is bolded, 'body' follows an em-dash. If this file is missing or invalid, the sender falls back to DEFAULT_WINBACK_HIGHLIGHTS in core/mailer.ts.

highlights.title: Gamma Chart
highlights.body: a live price-and-dealer-gamma terminal with the Gamma Flip, Call/Put Walls, and Max Pain drawn right on SPY, QQQ, SPX, and NDX — plus session rewind to replay how a level held.

highlights.title: My Dashboard
highlights.body: a customizable board you build from the pieces of ZeroGEX you use most — arrange the charts and cards how you like, and it saves your layout, settings, and symbols.

highlights.title: Trade Bias
highlights.body: a single, signed directional call that fuses the gamma and volatility regime with live price action, flow, tape, and momentum — for a multi-day swing or a same-day 0DTE read.

highlights.title: NDX coverage
highlights.body: the Nasdaq-100 now gets the same gamma read as SPY, SPX, and QQQ across every tool.
